_notice.title: Changes feed for official legal sources
_notice.what_this_is: Titles, identifiers, dates and links for legislation an official publisher has newly published or newly consolidated. It holds no text of any document. It is information, not legal advice, and it is not a complete or official list: follow the link and rely on the publisher.
_notice.credits: Titles, identifiers and dates are each publisher's. Show the attribution_line given under sources for every source whose items you show. No publisher endorses this feed.

licence.name: EUR-Lex legal notice; consolidated texts under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International

status_lines: Only European Union documents published in the Official Journal of the European Union are deemed authentic.
Extract only, where a single article or a capped passage is shown.
conditions: Documents with special conditions are title and link only: CELEX 32023R1803 and 32008R1126 (international accounting standards), every consolidated version of them, and any regulation whose title says it adopts or amends international accounting standards.
Third-party works inside a document, and content showing identifiable private individuals, may need their own permission.
